articles.title: Bitcoin researchers propose quantum fix that would not crowd out transactions
articles.snippet: The SHRINCS proposal would let bitcoin transactions use larger, quantum-resistant approvals while preserving more network capacity than existing post-quantum signature designs.

articles.title: Binance co-founders CZ and Yi He adopted Simpsons cartoon aliases ‘Homer’ and ‘Marge’ in company meetings
articles.snippet: Yi, who is now the co-CEO of Binance alongside its other chief Richard Teng, still uses the name Marge in meetings and chats.

articles.title: Nvidia shares rise after earnings top estimates, guides to $108 billion in revenue next quarter
articles.snippet: The tech bellwether reported fiscal second-quarter results after the bell on Wednesday.

articles.title: South Korea’s top financial conglomerate team up with Visa to test stablecoin issuance and B2B settlements
articles.snippet: Shinhan Financial Group will use Visa’s platform to test stablecoin issuance, remittance, and redemption while building new AI-powered payment models.

articles.title: Ethereum developers propose first step to protect ETH staking from quantum attacks
articles.snippet: A draft proposal would allow validators to deposit with quantum-resistant keys, then permanently stop accepting the format the network runs on today.
